ranked.headline: Structure-preserving representations for spatial and single-cell omics across modalities
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell omics methods now encode resolution, quality, and batch structure, exposing where learned representations still fail.

ranked.headline: Pretrained sequence language models applied to protein, mRNA and DNA tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark large pretrained sequence models on fitness, stability, and design tasks across proteins, mRNA and DNA.

ranked.headline: Open software tools for single-cell DNA, lentiviral integration, and leukemia data
ranked.summary: Recent releases extend analysis software from data processing into gene therapy safety surveillance and leukemia subtype prediction.

ranked.headline: Tools convert MS, metabolomics, and RNA-seq outputs into analysis-ready formats
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published tool target parsing, validation, and workflow integration for multi-platform omics outputs.

ranked.headline: Genome and metagenome mining links microbial sequence content to function and host state
ranked.summary: Expanded genome, metagenome, and pangenome collections now enable trait assignment from broad microbial sampling rather than aggregate diversity alone.

ranked.headline: Experimental restraints and force fields refine RNA and peptide conformational ensembles
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair NMR, chemical probing and force-field benchmarks to test how well models capture flexible biomolecular conformations.

ranked.headline: Graph attention over biomedical networks predicts interactions and perturbation effects
ranked.summary: Graph-based architectures now integrate knowledge graphs, multi-view networks, and genotype structures for interpretable biomedical prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational mini-protein binder design and epitope selectivity scoring for viral targets
ranked.summary: Experimentally confirmed computationally designed viral binders are now paired with new epitope selectivity scoring and complex benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Learned models score neoepitope immunogenicity and antibody developability
ranked.summary: FLAb2 finds protein AI models cannot yet consistently predict antibody developability, as neoepitope and glioblastoma vaccine pipelines advance.

ranked.headline: Selection and phage-bacteria dynamics shape bacterial and phage genetic variation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply selection and dynamical models to pneumococcal vaccine replacement, soil phage microdiversity, and in vitro phage-bacteria coexistence.

ranked.headline: Residue-level descriptors assess AlphaFold prediction quality and domain environments
ranked.summary: Whole-proteome AlphaFold-DB assessments and pLDDT analyses now make structure-derived quality metrics central to interpreting predicted models.

ranked.headline: Learned visual representations for cell and tissue analysis in biomedical imaging
ranked.summary: Foundation-model features and label-efficient classifiers are being adapted for cell phenotyping and slide-level classification in pathology and imaging.

ranked.headline: Modular tools scale sequence alignment and Z-nucleic acid mapping across genome datasets
ranked.summary: Million-genome databases and pan-domain metagenomes demand memory-efficient, automated tools, as XTree and ZSeekerDB illustrate.

ranked.headline: Attention models predict bacterial resistance, protein-ligand affinity and interactions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply genome-scale and structure-aware attention models to bacterial resistance, binding affinity, and interaction prediction.

ranked.headline: Scalable summary-statistics methods for heritability, genetic correlation, ancestry
ranked.summary: Python 3 ports and faster estimators make heritability and ancestry analyses cheaper on existing GWAS and LD resources.

ranked.headline: Recovering temporal and periodic structure from static single-cell measurements
ranked.summary: Single-cell snapshots and longitudinal datasets are being modeled with explicit temporal ordering and periodicity to infer dynamics and fitness.

ranked.headline: Intrinsic noise and delays shape timing, bistability, and adaptation in gene networks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study formalize stochastic timing limits and noise control in gene and biomolecular networks.

ranked.headline: Nanopore direct RNA sequencing calibration sharpens RNA modification site calling
ranked.summary: Parameter calibration and deep learning are tightening the precision of nanopore RNA modification and variant calling from long reads.

ranked.headline: Pangenome, acrocentric, and microRNA studies link structural genome change to function
ranked.summary: Near-complete assemblies and great ape and mammalian comparisons now resolve structural variants and miRNA orthology at population and lineage scale.

ranked.headline: Mechanical models couple cellular forces, flow and confinement to cell morphology
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair vertex, phase-field, and fluid-structure models with time-lapse and confinement data to infer or simulate cell-scale mechanics.

ranked.headline: Deep learning decodes EEG markers of consciousness, language coherence and prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply CNN and ML decoders to EEG during stimulation, language drift, and visual prediction, testing neural coherence measures.

ranked.headline: Primer design and reference tools refine targeted sequencing assay specificity and…
ranked.summary: Recent preprints offer validated, accessible tools for primer design, viral enrichment, and food metagenomic reference construction.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking omics methods and candidate biomarkers against reference standards
ranked.summary: Omics studies now test computational methods and candidate biomarkers against simulated data and defined reference conditions.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict protein-ligand affinity and drug-drug interactions
ranked.summary: Graph, capsule, and physics-aware neural networks are being applied to affinity and interaction prediction for candidate molecules.

ranked.headline: Chemist-style cues and shortcut learning complicate activity model benchmarking
ranked.summary: Recent studies show activity and ADME models can exploit confounds on public benchmarks, prompting shortcut-aware evaluation under distribution shift.

ranked.headline: Interaction structure sets extinction, cooperation, and ecosystem outcomes across systems
ranked.summary: Recent work quantifies how contact topology, spatial fragmentation, and link structure set epidemic, cooperative, and ecosystem outcomes.

ranked.headline: Deep learning variant models move toward noncoding and protein interaction effects
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply learned models to mitochondrial noncoding variants, missense edgetic effects, and cancer and metabolite networks.

ranked.headline: Pretrained transformers and all-atom predictors repurposed for molecular and peptide…
ranked.summary: Pretrained transformers and all-atom predictors are being inverted into generators for molecules and peptides under explicit chemical and geometric constraints.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved and T2T references reshape alignment and trait-gene discovery
ranked.summary: Recent work compares T2T-CHM13 with hg38 and builds haplotype-resolved and pangenome assemblies for alignment and trait analysis.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and haplotype-aware tools for CRISPR editing and cardiac regeneration
ranked.summary: Single-cell profiling now resolves CRISPR-induced mutations in vivo, while variant-aware guide design addresses population genetic effects on editing.

ranked.headline: MD simulations map residue-level determinants of amyloid aggregation and inhibition
ranked.summary: Atomistic simulations now localize aggregation-prone residues and inhibitor contacts in Tau, α-synuclein, Aβ and myocilin.

ranked.headline: Explicit computational models of cell and tissue systems tested against experimental data
ranked.summary: Explicit models now link cryopreservation, embryonic ciliary flow, and corneal epithelial repair to measured or literature data.

ranked.headline: Polarizable simulation and AlphaFold 3 sharpen nucleic acid binding and structure models
ranked.summary: Polarizable mapping of RNA and DNA binding sites and AlphaFold 3 ssDNA benchmarking extend nucleic acid structure assessment.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved assemblies of wild relatives map disease and pest resistance loci
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale haplotype-resolved assemblies now resolve allelic diversity at resistance loci in wild and related Carya, Aegilops, and Vitis germplasm.

ranked.headline: Testing genomic and causal factors within multi-omics networks and molecular programs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple multi-omics network inference with explicit modulator, causal, and program-level models for high-dimensional molecular data.
